data.title: Stolen Session Token Replay
data.description: Detects session token replay from a different geographic location or device than the original authenticating session. When infostealers exfiltrate active session cookies, attackers import them into antidetect browsers to hijack authenticated sessions without triggering login-based detections. This rule correlates session token usage across differing geolocations and device fingerprints.

detection.condition: selection and not filter_same_context | count() by session_token > 1

falsepositives: Users connecting via VPN whose egress IP changes geographic region mid-session
Mobile users roaming internationally with active banking sessions
